findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "table_to_excel" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Use this when the user wants a table turned into an Excel spreadsheet (.xlsx) or a CSV file: "convert this PDF table to Excel", "make this into a spreadsheet", …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
